profile.name: Kevin Falentio
profile.headline: Software engineer
profile.summary: I build developer tooling and web services, mostly in TypeScript and Go. My work spans editor and CLI plugins, OpenAI-compatible gateways, Svelte front ends, and published libraries. I like typed modules and checks a reviewer can rerun.

projects.name: meowvie
bullets: Built a three-repository movie and anime download service: a Go API on Fiber, a Node crawler monorepo with six site scrapers, and a Deno Fresh front end.
Added Bleve full-text search, GORM over SQLite, and an LRU cache in front of the movie repository so repeated queries skip the database.
Measured 30 concurrent queries on a 256 MB Fly.io instance: 29.8 requests per second over 10 seconds, slowest response 500 ms.

projects.name: commandcode
bullets: Wrote an OpenAI-compatible gateway in Go with the standard library, serving /v1/chat/completions and /v1/models behind CORS and request-logging middleware, rotating upstream keys round-robin.
Built an OpenCode v2 plugin that fetches the model catalog, generates provider model configs, and starts a local proxy; six test files run under vitest.
Shipped a second OpenCode plugin that ports the pstack agent-workflow skill set into OpenCode, 201 files with 8 test files.

projects.name: ty
bullets: Published a typed event emitter to JSR as jsr:@falentio/ty, with Deno and npm entry points and no dependencies.
Typed event names and payloads at the library boundary so a mismatched listener fails at compile time rather than at runtime.

projects.name: art-trace
bullets: Built a SvelteKit app on Cloudflare Workers that traces artwork styles through Gemini, using Drizzle ORM over libSQL for storage.
Set up Playwright and vitest browser-mode tests alongside svelte-check and valibot schema validation.

projects.name: dotfiles
bullets: Wrote an idempotent POSIX shell installer that symlinks ~/.pi and ~/.agents into the repo, timestamp-backs up any real file it replaces, and leaves foreign symlinks untouched.
Keeps the agent skills, prompts, and editor config the whole workflow runs on under version control and rerunnable from a fresh machine.
